polls.description: Chinese companies are securing massive funding and ordering hundreds of thousands of Huawei chips as China accelerates domestic AI infrastructure amid US restrictions.
polls.question: Is China's domestic AI chip push innovation or a risky isolation?

cluster_stories.title: Malaysia Eyes Huawei Chips for AI Project Despite US Warning
cluster_stories.summary: Malaysia is leaning toward relying on Huawei Technologies Co.’s artificial intelligence chips to power its sovereign AI efforts, in what would be a major victory for Chinese AI technology in the face of strong opposition from President Donald Trump’s administration.
cluster_stories.headline: MALAYSIA EYES HUAWEI AI CHIPS DESPITE US WARNING

cluster_stories.title: ByteDance secures $29.6 billion loan in AI push, sources say
cluster_stories.summary: ByteDance secured a massive $29.6 billion loan from nearly thirty banks. Chinese banks provided over sixty percent of this significant loan facility. The funds will primarily support ByteDance's ambitious overseas artificial intelligence expansion plans. This unsecured loan reflects strong lender confidence in the company's creditworthiness. The financing is the second-largest in Asia this year, highlighting sector enthusiasm.
cluster_stories.headline: BYTEDANCE SECURES $29.6B LOAN FOR AI PUSH... CHINA BANKS LEAD

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek Plans Big Huawei AI Chip Order to Power New Data Center
cluster_stories.summary: DeepSeek plans to deploy at least 160,000 of Huawei Technologies Co.’s top accelerators at a massive data center it’s building in Inner Mongolia, which could create one of the largest known clusters of Huawei AI chips and advance China’s efforts to replace Nvidia Corp.
cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK ORDERS 160K HUAWEI CHIPS... MASSIVE DATA CENTER PLAY

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek plans big Huawei AI chip order to power new data centre
cluster_stories.summary: The startup doesn’t currently plan to use the 950DT chips for training, one of the people said, even though Huawei designed and marketed these processors to serve that more demanding function. While DeepSeek tried to train its previous models on Huawei chips, it has so far relied on Nvidia accelerators for this crucial step.
cluster_stories.headline: DeepSeek Orders Big Batch of Huawei AI Chips for New Data Center

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek plans large Huawei chip order for new Inner Mongolia data centre
cluster_stories.summary: DeepSeek is preparing a large order of Huawei AI chips for a new data centre, according to Bloomberg. Neither the size of the order nor the chip model has been disclosed, and DeepSeek has not confirmed the plan. The data centre has been reported since the summer. cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK ORDERS MASSIVE HUAWEI CHIP HAUL FOR INNER MONGOLIA

polls.description: Major Chinese AI companies are securing massive chip orders from Huawei and billions in financing to build data centers, bypassing US export restrictions.
